name: Fatma Simon
headline: User Experience Manager bei Tangity — part of NTT DATA Design Network
summary:
Team Lead / Project Manager / UX Designer with more than 12 years of professional experience in overall IT with 10 years in SAP IT/Consultancy area.

Current has worked with Angular, SAP Fiori for MindSphere & SAP HANA APP Design, Software Development, Systems Integration and Roll Out projects in different roles, as: Project Manager, SCRUM Master, User Experience Designer and Application Consultant. Design Thinking, UX Design, AGILE Methodology and SAP Data Migration experience in different industries as Telecom, Energy and Automotive.

Responsibilities in projects involved:
•	Transforming traditional methods with Agile Frameworks
•	Coordinating teams transition through the Design-Led Development process
•	Transforming customer business needs into the requirements for customization & configuration of 
        the products
•	Understanding of business processes and system functionality
•	Provide technical content of customer requirements
